# 🔌 api-testing

API test automation with Playwright and contract testing.

Install: `api-testing@jaktestowac`. See the [quick start](https://github.com/jaktestowac/awesome-agents-for-quality#-quick-start) for each tool.

## Skills

- [`api-playwright-test-developer`](skills/api-playwright-test-developer/SKILL.md)
- [`testing-api-contracts`](skills/testing-api-contracts/SKILL.md)

## Commands

Run these yourself: `/name` in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, `$name` in Codex. The agent never starts them on its own.

- [`api-test-plan-and-tests`](skills/api-test-plan-and-tests/SKILL.md): API test plan and test generator

## Agents

| Agent | Claude Code | GitHub Copilot | Codex |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| API Test Automation (from OpenAPI spec) | [`api-test-automation-openapi`](agents/api-test-automation-openapi.md) | [`api-test-automation-openapi`](.github/agents/api-test-automation-openapi.agent.md) | [`api_test_automation_openapi`](codex/agents/api-test-automation-openapi.toml) |
| OpenAPI Test Automation Expert | [`openapi-test-automation-expert`](agents/openapi-test-automation-expert.md) | [`openapi-test-automation-expert`](.github/agents/openapi-test-automation-expert.agent.md) | [`openapi_test_automation_expert`](codex/agents/openapi-test-automation-expert.toml) |

Claude Code and GitHub Copilot load these agents with the plugin.
Codex does not load agents from plugins: copy the files from [`codex/agents/`](codex/agents/) into your project's `.codex/agents/` or into `~/.codex/agents/`.
